projects.title: Nimbus
projects.description: Open-source the cloud. self-hosted VM provisioning platform - the EC2 experience on hardware you own.Built a single-binary Go + React platform that gives users self-service VM provisioning on Proxmox clusters in under 60 seconds. Features include automatic node selection with live cluster scoring, atomic IP allocation, public HTTPS exposure via reverse tunnel integration, GPU compute on paired NVIDIA hardware, RBAC, quotas, and a cordon/drain/migrate operational model inspired by Kubernetes. Developed at LAHacks 2026 (won the Arista Networks track) and actively maintained as an open source project.Tech: Go, React/TypeScript, SQLite, Proxmox REST API, cloud-init.GitHub: github.com/smalex-z/nimbus

projects.title: Gopher
projects.description: Public router for private services. Self-hosted reverse tunnel system with automatic HTTPS and subdomain routing. Expose homelab services, research servers, or any private machine via clean URLs - no port forwarding needed.

projects.title: Cloud Computing Server Virtualization Solution (Mini-AWS)
projects.description: ●Set up and manage enterprise-level server solution with two cross-country server clusters running Linux Debian Type 1 Hypervisors, concurrently hosting 10 Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows virtual machines.●Created reliable and scalable ‘Mini-AWS’ cloud environment using multiple virtualized Ubuntu VMs to host web applications and databases with load-balancing, replicating cloud-like services.●Achieved cost savings of $1000 annually by migrating multiple web applications from Amazon EC2 instances to on-premises server clusters, allowing for better control over hardware and enhanced data privacy.●Configured Nginx as a reverse proxy to route traffic to multiple virtual machines using a single public IP address.

projects.title: tinyCV.co
projects.description: Creator & Project Lead •AWS based site that provides a simple and professional domain name for clients to create and share their own personal websites on their resumes.•Hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS) running an Ubuntu/Linux server with a Nginx reverse proxy from Django port 8000 to HTTP/HTTPS ports 80/443.•Obtained Amazon issued HTTPS/SSL certificate enabling encrypted connection.•Delivered client analytics using Google Analytics integration.•As Project Lead, managed a cross-functional team, strategically assigning tasks based on team members' strengths. Furthermore, leveraged GitHub for efficient team collaboration and developmental workflow.
